messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Associate to nearest TSS with bed file (chr, start and end)
parts:
You have to read the file as a GRanges object, then you have to get the TSS annotations as GRanges. readTranscriptFeatures from genomation can get the TSS from a bed file. Then, you can use genomation::annotateWithGeneParts to get the distances to the nearest TSS. You can also use GenomicRanges function distanceToNearest at this point.

Best,
Altuna
